resources.title: Final Fantasy XIV Beginner's Guide (2026) - Tips and Tricks for New Players
resources.creator: LinksterGames
resources.noteEs: Guía comprehensiva para quien arranca FFXIV en 2026. Cubre Free Trial, MSQ flow, primer job, mecánicas básicas de combate y los errores típicos de newbies. Buen primer recurso antes del onboarding del juego.
resources.noteEn: Comprehensive guide for anyone starting FFXIV in 2026. Covers Free Trial, MSQ flow, first job, basic combat mechanics, and typical newbie mistakes. A good first resource before the in-game onboarding.

resources.title: The Barriers to Getting into FFXIV!
resources.creator: Caetsu Chaiji Ch.
resources.noteEs: Análisis honesto de los obstáculos que enfrentan los new players de FFXIV: duración del MSQ, learning curve de combat, y expectativas vs realidad. Útil para amigos que dudan si invertir.
resources.noteEn: Honest analysis of the obstacles new FFXIV players face: MSQ length, combat learning curve, and expectations vs reality. Useful for friends on the fence about investing the time.

resources.title: So I Returned To FFXIV...
resources.creator: Zepla HQ
resources.noteEs: Perspectiva de Zepla volviendo a FFXIV tras un break. Útil para returners: qué hizo, qué le sorprendió post-Dawntrail, cómo retomó la MSQ y endgame.
resources.noteEn: Zepla's perspective returning to FFXIV after a break. Useful for returners: what she did, what surprised her post-Dawntrail, how she resumed MSQ and endgame.

resources.title: Why FFXIV is BACK!
resources.creator: Cole Evyx
resources.noteEs: Análisis del momentum positivo de FFXIV en 2026 tras el pre-FanFest. Bueno para entender qué generó el comeback narrative y por qué hay buena ventana para empezar/volver.
resources.noteEn: Analysis of FFXIV's positive momentum in 2026 after pre-FanFest. Good for understanding what triggered the comeback narrative and why there's a good window to start/return.

resources.title: Dawntrail is NOT too hard | FFXIV
resources.creator: Larryzaur
resources.noteEs: Respuesta directa al discourse de que Dawntrail tenía contenido muy difícil. Larryzaur explica los new mechanics y pone en context la dificultad. Evergreen para new players intimidados por Savage commentary.
resources.noteEn: Direct response to the discourse that Dawntrail had overly hard content. Larryzaur explains the new mechanics and contextualizes the difficulty. Evergreen for new players intimidated by Savage commentary.
